page_title: Alpha3D - The full AI 3D pipeline, in one place

sources.entry: Alpha3D - Alpha3D is a revolutionary generative AI-powered platform that transforms 2D images into high-quality 3D assets at scale. #paid

summary.name: Alpha3D
summary.one_liner: Alpha3D is an AI 3D platform that turns a text prompt or photo into a game-ready 3D model and continues through retopology, UV unwrapping, texturing, rigging and export.
use_cases: Generating game-ready 3D assets for indie games
Cleaning up AI-generated meshes for studio pipelines
Turning product photos into 3D models for e-commerce
Preparing watertight STL files for 3D printing
Creating rigged FBX characters for Unity or Unreal
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a web app where a user generates a 3D mesh from a prompt, a photo, or up to eight angles, then refines it with retopology, UV unwrap, texturing and rigging. Finished assets can be exported as GLB, FBX, OBJ or STL. A Workflows node canvas lets users chain these steps into reusable graphs and run them in batches. Alphred, a conversational agent, can drive the tools by chat messages. The same pipeline is offered as a Blender add-on, a REST API and an MCP connector for Claude and ChatGPT.
notable: Covers the full chain from generation through retopology, UVs, textures, rig and export in one tab
Workflows node canvas for reusable, batch-runnable pipelines
Blender add-on, REST API and MCP connector for Claude and ChatGPT
Conversational agent Alphred drives the tools by message
caveats: Paid service: plans start at €5/mo for the Tester plan, and jobs consume credits (conversion costs 12 credits)
Commercial use is stated as available on any paid plan only
